baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison in فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ carries one oath behavior across the divine and human audiences.
baseline_models.mechanism: Resurrection reactivates rather than reforms their speech routine: the same oath used before people is deployed before God, and the closing nominal identification makes falsehood a stable actor-profile rather than one isolated proposition.

activation_trace.role: Stirring the stationary supplies the forced reactivation in which their old speech routine resumes.
The oath is the repeated speech act whose transfer between audiences exposes the routine.
Contrariety to truth converts the repeated oath from a momentary tactic into the identity named at the close.

changed_reading.before: They tell God a lie after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Their audience-management routine is raised with them and runs unchanged even before God, revealing a durable identity organized around false speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated حلف, the audience markers له and لكم, and the claimed position على شيء support a relational reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because حلف can image both an oath and an alliance that adheres, their swearing can perform claimed affiliation, not only assert a fact. They suppose this portable profession of loyalty preserves a real standing with whichever audience confronts them.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and adhesion make the oath a performed claim of belonging whose addressee can be switched.
Supposition supplies their inward estimate that the performed affiliation succeeds.
A knowable, reportable thing gives their claimed standing the appearance of objective substance.

changed_reading.before: They swear to a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: They try to preserve relational standing by performing sworn allegiance and mistake that performance for substantive affiliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ places their estimate beside the spatial image of being upon something.
baseline_models.mechanism: The count/estimate range of حسب and the reportable-object range of شيء make the clause an internal accounting: they have assigned positive value and solidity to their own position. The emphatic liar verdict is an external audit that rejects both the claim and the metric.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning supply the image of an internal ledger that yields a favorable balance.
Supposition keeps that favorable reckoning epistemically defective rather than factual.
The general knowable thing functions as the supposedly solid substrate beneath their position.
The truth/falsehood judgment overturns the favorable self-assessment.

changed_reading.before: They vaguely think they are right.
changed_reading.after: They conduct a self-serving reckoning that mistakes their position for objective, load-bearing substance, and the verse audits that reckoning as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا supplies a severe time, forced activation, and collection without remainder.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening compresses scattered persons into one exposed assembly and stirs them from inactivity; what appears under that pressure is not a new defense but their familiar oath. Total gathering therefore functions as a disclosure mechanism for behavioral continuity.

activation_trace.role: The day as a severe event gives the disclosure scene concentrated pressure rather than mere chronology.
Stirring from rest activates the persons and the behavior they carry.
Completion without omission makes the exposure total: no person or fragment of the group remains outside it.

changed_reading.before: Everyone is resurrected at the same time.
changed_reading.after: A complete forced assembly acts as a pressure test, exposing that their earthly oath behavior persists intact beyond death.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the same day-raising-totality frame, 58:6 supplies a reported record, exhaustive divine enumeration, human forgetting, and witness. Against that audit, 58:18's حسب becomes a rival human accounting: their oaths submit a favorable story and على شيء states its positive balance, but the final verdict rejects the account.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning anchors the focus clause as the human counter-account exposed by the context audit.
The supposedly reportable substance is what their counter-account claims to establish.
A delivered report supplies the authoritative disclosure against which their sworn story is measured.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies the complete divine ledger that displaces their self-reckoning.
Loss of remembered material explains why their own account is informationally defective.
Presence with observation closes the evidentiary gap their oath performance tries to exploit.

structural_cues: 58:6 repeats the day, raising, and total gathering scaffold of 58:18 before sequencing report, enumeration, forgetting, and witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an authoritative report, exhaustive count, human forgetting, and witness; I infer that this turns the focus حسب into a rival self-audit. A live alternative is that حسب remains ordinary delusion while 58:6 only supplies the judgment setting.

changed_reading.before: Their belief is an unspecified mental mistake.
changed_reading.after: Their belief is a defective counter-account offered inside a scene already governed by an exhaustive record; their oath and claimed balance cannot alter the ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence turns oath into an operating technology. 58:14 explicitly binds swearing to known falsehood; 58:16 makes plural oaths a protective cover that enables diversion; and 58:8 activates حسب as sufficiency. In 58:18 they therefore keep using the cover before God because they have mistaken its repeated social success for sufficient footing.

activation_trace.role: The repeated focus oath is the tactic whose operation the context sequence reveals.
Their supposition converts prior tactical success into the false expectation that the cover still works.
The sufficiency branch supplies a reversal: what they count as adequate cover meets the context's counter-sufficiency.
The earlier oath identifies the same recurrent tactic before its resurrection-scene repetition.
Explicit falsehood, paired there with knowledge, removes accidental error as the account of the oath tactic.
Oaths in the plural supply the accumulated instrument they have adopted.
Protective covering assigns the oath its defensive function rather than treating it as speech alone.
Turning away and diverting supplies the outward work enabled by the oath-cover.

structural_cues: 58:14 binds oath to falsehood while stating that they know.
58:16 converts their oaths into a protective object and immediately follows it with diversion from God's path.
58:8 places حسب in a sufficiency formula that reverses their confidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies known false oath, adopted oath-cover, resulting diversion, and a sufficiency use of حسب; I infer the arrow oath to cover to confidence of footing. A live alternative is that the tactics and the delusion coexist without the cover causing the confidence.

changed_reading.before: They happen to repeat a lie before a new audience.
changed_reading.after: They redeploy a practiced oath-cover before God because its earthly utility has trained them to count it as sufficient protection and substantive standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah denies that wealth and descendants can avail them in any thing before God. Its indefinite شيئا echoes the focus شيء and supplies concrete candidates for what they imagine themselves to be upon: accumulated resources and lineage. The focus claim is thus a misvaluation of capital as adequate ground.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency frames their estimate as a claim that their available supports are enough.
The deliberately general object leaves a slot that the preceding assets can fill without exhausting it.
Adequacy and sufficiency state the precise function that the listed supports fail to perform.
Accumulated wealth supplies one concrete form of the substance they may count beneath themselves.
Descendants supply inherited and social continuity as a second imagined support.
The echoed indefinite thing negates any effective remainder from those assets before God.

structural_cues: 58:17 immediately precedes the focus and pairs named assets with an indefinite شيئا that reappears in 58:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed wealth, failed descendants, and the repeated indefinite thing; I infer that these assets partially fill the focus ayah's deliberately open شيء. A live alternative is that the focus term stays broader and points chiefly to doctrinal or political standing.

changed_reading.before: They imagine themselves to have some unspecified valid position.
changed_reading.after: They have capitalized wealth and lineage into a supposed platform before God, even though the preceding ayah has already reduced both supports to no effective thing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah sequences domination, induced forgetting of God's remembrance, and factional identity. This supplies a cognitive-social mechanism for the focus estimate: their false calculation is maintained by captured attention and group belonging. The liar identity can therefore include an inhabited false self-model while still retaining deliberate outward oath-making.

activation_trace.role: Supposition is the focus-level cognitive output for which the context supplies a capture mechanism.
The lying self keeps open a reflexive dimension in the emphatic identity statement.
Domination and seizure supply the controlling force over their cognition and collectivity.
Loss of remembrance removes corrective material from their self-assessment.
Recall after forgetting names the corrective cognition that has been displaced.
A group consolidated around one view gives the distorted estimate social reinforcement and identity.

structural_cues: 58:19 follows immediately and uses a causal sequence: domination, caused forgetting, then factional identification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domination, induced forgetting, lost remembrance, and faction identity; I infer an arrow from captured memory to distorted self-calculation. A live alternative is that the sequence explains persistence in conduct but does not broaden كاذبون beyond conscious outward lying.

changed_reading.before: They knowingly deceive others while privately seeing the truth.
changed_reading.after: Their outward perjury coexists with a socially reinforced false self-model: captured remembrance lets them inhabit the very estimate their oath performance manufactures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending contrasts self-issued standing with conferred standing. In 58:21 divine writing establishes the victorious outcome and gathered strength; in 58:22 faith is written in hearts, strengthened, and embodied in a named party. Against that, 58:18's portable spoken oath is a counterfeit credential: they say themselves onto a platform that has neither decree nor inward inscription.

activation_trace.role: Performed alliance is the self-issued credential contrasted with the context's written belonging.
The supposedly objective thing is the standing that their spoken credential claims to establish.
Binding inscription establishes an outcome by judgment or decree rather than by repeated assertion.
Prevailing force supplies the real outcome secured by the divine inscription.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies actual load-bearing capacity in contrast to imagined footing.
Faith written inwardly supplies a credential established in the heart rather than performed at the mouth.
The heart locates genuine standing in an interior center instead of an audience-facing oath.
Conferred strengthening gives that written standing effective support.
The named collectivity supplies genuine belonging as the social counterpart to the false performed allegiance.

structural_cues: كتب is repeated across 58:21-22, first for the settled outcome and then for faith in hearts.
The closing sequence moves from decree to strength to inward inscription to named collective belonging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine inscription, victory, gathered strength, heart-location, strengthening, and party identity; I infer that these form a legitimacy test for the focus claim to be على شيء. A live alternative is that the ending contrasts outcomes generally without directly classifying the oath as a counterfeit credential.

changed_reading.before: Their claim to standing is simply incorrect.
changed_reading.after: Their standing is self-issued through portable speech, whereas actual standing in the ending is decreed, inscribed inwardly, strengthened, and given a real collective identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses a materially distant كذب branch in which milk expected to continue fails, so it should be rendered only as an image of collapse, not as the lexical sense of كاذبون. It remains worth carrying because it is directly anchored in the focus root and converts the final identity from semantic untruth alone into non-durability under testing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic close إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْكَاذِبُونَ bears the direct ك ذ ب anchor.

activation_trace.role: Milk that was expected to endure but disappears images a claimed yield whose apparent continuity fails at the final test.

changed_reading.before: The liar is defined only by saying what is untrue.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their false identity also marks claims whose apparent yield and durability vanish when carried into the resurrection scene.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shackle branch of جمع is form-distant from the adverb جميعًا, so downstream prose must label it a secondary pressure-image rather than a translation. It remains anchored in the opening root and usefully tests whether total collection also implies loss of maneuver rather than neutral co-presence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَمِيعًا directly anchors the gathering root at the point where every person is brought into one scene.

activation_trace.role: The restraint that joins hands to neck supplies an exploratory undertone of constrained agency within total collection.

changed_reading.before: All means only that no member of the group is absent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, complete collection also removes the maneuvering space on which their audience-switching oath strategy depended.

strongest_changes: The repeated resurrection scaffold of 58:6 turns حسب into a defective counter-ledger confronted by exhaustive enumeration and witness.
The 58:14-16 sequence reveals the oath as protective infrastructure, while 58:8 supplies a sufficiency reversal for their confidence in it.
The immediate شيء echo in 58:17 lets wealth and descendants partially fill the focus ayah's otherwise open claim to substantive footing.
58:19 supplies captured memory and factional reinforcement as a mechanism for self-deception, while 58:21-22 contrast spoken credentials with decreed and inwardly inscribed standing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah already joins reactivated oath behavior, self-reckoning, and an objectless claim to footing. Context changes these from a generic lie into competing evidence systems, an oath-cover with social utility, a mispriced asset base, and a captured group cognition; the ending then supplies a distinct model of genuine standing without forcing the readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: على شيء may point particularly to wealth, lineage, and factional position, or may remain deliberately broader than all three.
The emphatic liar identity may include reflexive self-deception, but the explicit known false oath in 58:14 keeps conscious outward perjury primary.
The inscription contrast in 58:21-22 may directly expose a counterfeit credential in 58:18, or may function only as a broader contrast of outcomes and affiliations.
